title: Colombo National Museum
geometryBasis: The 25 native points hold the main building, projected portico and attached galleries. The Natural History Museum is a separate mapped building.
sectionBasis: The original lawn elevation sets the entrance datum. The two-storey arches, prominent pediments and corner bays follow the 1896 view, with later wings represented within their surveyed perimeter.
limitations: The old image establishes the surviving front section. The roof divisions, rear and side elevations, smaller ornamental features and gallery heights are approximate.
The Natural History Museum, freestanding grounds monuments and museum interiors are outside the main-building scope.
